text:
alex: seeing a spike of missed pages for customer-payments, alert-adapter returning 403 to PagerFlow. customer is reporting delayed transaction alerts :grimacing:

alex: logs (trimmed):
```
2026-03-17T10:12:02Z ERROR notify-adapter: outgoing webhook rejected 403 {"error":"signature mismatch"}
2026-03-17T10:12:02Z WARN retrying later
```

sam: hmm, we rotated the notifier signing key yesterday at 09:55 but I don't see a deploy to the adapter cluster. could be staled secret in k8s. :eyes:

jin: incident-bot didn't escalate either — channel automation suppressed because of 403 responses from the webhook target, so no automated oncall pages. customers got no mobile SMS for ~10m.

rachel: confirmed a customer impact window ~10-22m depending on region. i'm adding that to the incident summary and pinging CS to triage escalations.

alex: temporary mitigation: i'm going to flip adapter to use the previous signing key and restart the deployment. can someone cut manual pages to oncall while we flip?

oncall-sms: manual page sent to mobile oncall roster (sms) for svc-payments, 10:34 UTC. ack pending.

sam: rolling back secret now and restarting pods: `kubectl -n notify set env deploy/alert-adapter SIGN_KEY=old-key && kubectl rollout restart deploy/alert-adapter`

ops-bot: deploy rollout started (deploy/alert-adapter) — watch: `kubectl rollout status`

jin: ack from oncall at 10:37. starting live mitigation: re-run blocked alerts (queue replay) against PagerFlow once adapter healthy.

alex: after rollback adapter began accepting webhooks. I replayed the failed batch (IDs: 4751..4763). PagerFlow accepted 12/13 on first try; one still 5xx, retried.

rachel: customer-facing note drafted: short delay in transaction alerts for a subset of customers, mitigation in place, follow-up timeline for RCA and postmortem. CCed support.

sam: root cause: rotation runbook updated, but the rotation job didn't patch the k8s secret name used by alert-adapter (human error + missing test). immediate fix: update rotation script to `kubectl patch secret` and restart, and add a canary deploy step. TODO created: INC-4021.

alex: follow-ups: 1) add healthcheck that validates webhook signing acceptance 2) incident-bot should emit metered count of 403s to #eng-sre so automation can triage earlier 3) playbook: if OTA key rotation hits >5 403s in 5m, pause rotation and alert oncall explicitly.

jin: adding rollback steps to the on-call runbook now.

rachel: good. after-action: aim for a 24h blameless postmortem and timeline. I'll own the comms. :white_check_mark:
